neighbours.label: a first-person speech or reply verb in a narrative: 'I asked', 'I answered', 'I assured'; the + pole is the third-person 'he says' side
fire: "Tomorrow?" I asked, putting down my cup.
"Of course," I answered, trying not to laugh.
I assured the nurse I would come back soon.
"Who told you?" I asked. She only shrugged.
I told the driver that I had no change.
"Maybe later," I replied, reaching for my coat.
I promised my sister I would call on Sunday.
"Really?" I said, looking up from the book.
